_readme: The Standard at Austin, 715 W 23rd St, as js/slopes-apartments.js draws it. Every number cites a source key from `sources` in a sibling `_src` field; a value with no source says so. Metres, in the footprint's own oriented bounding box (js/westcampus.js obbOf): +u runs WEST along 23rd St (bearing 274.7°), +v runs SOUTH; u=0 is the east end, v=0 the north (23rd St) edge, L=94.9 m, W=46.5 m. Read docs/apartments.md for the schema.
name: The Standard

sources.S1: OSM way 380916747 (Overpass, 2026-09-05): building=apartments, addr 715 West 23rd Street; no height, no building:levels; no building:part in the bbox.
sources.S2: data/snapshots/2026-08-27/buildings.detailed.geojson feature 36365d18-2eb6-43c5-b042-6197e7767e17: the 18-vertex footprint, final_height 20.5 (overture — wrong by 2.8x, see S3).
sources.S3: SkyscraperPage forum thread t=236383: 'AUSTIN | The Standard at Austin | 191 FT | 17 FLOORS | T.O.' — 58.2 m to top of structure, 17 storeys; the storey count is also on Humphreys & Partners' page (S4) and apartments.com.
sources.S4: Humphreys & Partners, humphreys.com/project/the-standard-at-austin: 17-story Type IA, 287 units, 640 spaces, 4,116 sq ft retail, '33,000 sq ft on 7th floor including pool deck ... double-volume gym, yoga room, sky deck lounge, and courtyard', completed Fall 2021.
sources.S5: research/union24th-area/imagery/web/the-standard-at-austin/humphreys_00.jpg (= Humphreys' StandardAustin_Ext_14, blue hour, from the 23rd/Pearl intersection — the street sign in frame reads W 23rd St 700 / Pearl St 2300): the charcoal corner bay with THE STANDARD on both faces, the two-storey-tall storefront ground floor, the light-panel podium with punched windows and small balconies along Pearl (4 rows above the ground floor), the pixel-panel tower with the vertical sign, the balcony tower with rust strips, the charcoal strip at its corner.
sources.S6: humphreys_01.jpg (dusk aerial from the north, over the Union on 24th's site): the whole north elevation — the lower east wing with a garden roof, 5 window rows on the podium east of the corner bay, the pool deck with the jumbotron between the towers, tower A (pixel, vertical sign at the east end of its north face), tower B (white with rust strips and two columns of balconies on its north face; pixel with a vertical sign on its west face), the double-volume glazed gym between them at deck level.
sources.S7: humphreys_05.jpg (pool deck looking south-west): the lap pool with the jumbotron wall at its east end and the balcony tower's north face behind; one balcony per bay, black tube rails, on every floor above the deck.
sources.S8: Google Earth 3D, captured 2026-09-05 via scripts/verify/chrome.mjs (page.screenshot): nadir @30.28699,-97.74578,190a,260d,35y,0h,0t, rectified into this (u,v) frame at 0.164 m/px (scale bar 183 px = 30 m; the footprint polygon overlaid lands on the roof edges); obliques at 220 m/55° from the SW (45h) and NW (135h); 300 m/60° from the N (180h), E (270h) and S (0h). Imagery date 12/2023.
sources.S9: js/westcampus.js TIER4.STD and scripts/bake_westcampus.py MIDRISE['The Standard']: the deck features read off the rectified z20 nadir in this same frame (pool, spa, turf, cabana, screen, rail), the balcony module read off Ext_01, the liner height 21.5 corroborated by the roofscape LiDAR deck (b=21.50), the ground floor 7.0/6.0, the corner bay 13.3 m wide, the panel tones measured off Ext_14 (STD_CREAM/PALE/WARM, BASE_STD, STD_RUST, STD_CAP). TIER4's two 'slabs' [23.5-41, 57.2-74.3] x [17-31.4] are NOT the towers: overlaid on the nadir (S8) they land exactly on the two light wells.
sources.S10: data/roads.geojson: West 23rd Street's western segment runs along this building's NORTH edge (lat 30.28721-30.28745) and Pearl Street ends at it at the building's NW corner (-97.746318, 30.287326); Rio Grande is 58 m east of the east edge. So S5's corner is the north-west corner.
sources.S11: Rambler ATX review (rambleratx.com/resources/apartment-review-standard-austin): first floor is leasing office + Luxer package room + retail; pool deck has a jumbotron, two hot tubs, an outdoor kitchen.
sources.S13: The judge's fair-comparison package (scratchpad apts/judge/standard/, 2026-09-06): B.png = the S8 south-west oblique (Earth @30.28699,-97.74578,190a,220d,35y,45h,55t, imagery 12/2023) cropped to the building beside ours at the same camera. On the south face the white/rust bays run from the roof straight down to a ONE-storey dark base — twelve window rows show above the neighbouring garage's roof, where ours had nine over six storeys of charcoal screen; at the SW corner the dark base under the tower is two residential storeys (~6 m) with the cafe's glazing in it.
sources.S12: js/westcampus.js SOLID: the West Campus pass's day/golden/night trios for a pool, deck paving, turf, shade, furniture, black steel rail, balcony slab, the jumbotron screen and the white sign letters — entered cool for top faces, dark at night, the pool lit.
sources.derived: a number computed from the above and marked so; 'unknown' stays unknown.
sources.S14: Owner photographs 1-3 of 2026-09-06, transcribed by the lead in the session scratchpad (next/standard-owner-photos.md); the photographs are not on disk. Photo 1 (dusk oblique, the whole building; its content — garage right, The Block on 23rd far right, construction foreground — is the S6 view from the north-west): the pixel skin is solid charcoal rectangles on an off-white field, ~70/30 light/dark, on the blank flanks only; THE STANDARD vertical on both towers; the podium is LIGHT with rust accent strips on scattered bays and small black juliet balconies; charcoal at the ground floor and in the sign band at the podium top. Photo 2 (aerial over the deck): lap pool, a separate square spa with a raised edge, vivid turf patches, a row of blue loungers along the pool, teal chairs and tables on the turf, palms in square tiled planters, the jumbotron on the tower wall, cabanas with dark flat canopies on slender posts, a dark slatted privacy screen on one deck edge with the condensers behind it. Photo 3 (on the deck): the spa's coping reads 3 FT 0 IN, blue mosaic tile, string lights, balconies with black rails stepping up the tower. Eyeball hex in the transcription (~#e9e9e7 field, ~#4a4e54 marks, ~#c1622e rust, ~#35a8c8 pool, ~#7ac143 turf) — sampled values below cite the photograph they were measured on.
sources.S15: humphreys_00.jpg (= Ext_14, S5) read again at 3x crops on 2026-09-06 for the skins: the corner bay is charcoal for its FULL height above the storefront on both street faces with a four-storey glazed corner stack (floor-to-ceiling glass per floor, thin spandrels) at the corner and small black balconies beside it on the 23rd St face; its top storey (18.4-21.5) is windowless and carries the horizontal signs (letters ~0.85 m tall, the text block ~9 m long starting ~0.5 m from the corner on 23rd and ~1 m from it on Pearl); the podium beside it is light grey panel, one tall window per ~3.1 m bay with a storey-tall rust strip immediately LEFT of the window on every third bay and a juliet balcony (black rail, ~1.7 m wide, ~0.35 m deep) on those bays; tower B's west face is the pixel field at its north end with THE STANDARD vertical about three quarters of the way along the field from the north corner, then white bays with rust strips and tall windows, then — at the building's south-west corner — a stacked balcony column whose slabs and rails read from the north as a dark vertical stripe with two lit window columns (the 'dark charcoal panel' of S14 photo 1; it is balconies, not panel: the Earth mesh S8 shows the slabs projecting west); the pixel field also reaches the ground in a ~4 m strip on the Pearl podium under the tower's field, light podium either side of it.
sources.S16: humphreys_01.jpg (S6) at 3-4x crops, 2026-09-06: tower A's north face is 25 m of pixel with ONE lit slit column at 0.29 of the width from the east end and THE STANDARD vertical at 0.68 from the east end (7-8 m from the west corner), the letters from ~2.8 m below the roof to ~15.5 m below it (12.7 m for twelve characters), on a plain white column clear of dark marks; the dark marks are ~1.3 m tall (two panel courses) and 2.4-7 m long, about 26 % of the field by k-means (#4c5153 dark / #9fa4a8 light at dusk), the field WHITE with a few mid-grey planks; tower B's north face has SIX bays of ~2.66 m over 15.95 m — a balcony column flush at the east corner, four window bays each with a rust strip immediately left of its window, a balcony column 2.1 m in from the west corner; the podium's north face has five window rows above the storefront, juliets on every third bay, and two one-storey dark louvre panels in the top storey just east of the corner bay.
sources.S17: Google Earth 3D at the two recorded obliques (S8: SW @45h and NW @135h, imagery 12/2023), read at 4-6x crops on 2026-09-06 — daylight colour and the west face's composition: the south face is white-grey panel (k-means #d6dcda lit / #afb0a6 shaded) with rust strips (#a8553a-class) on ALTERNATE bay lines, about every 5 m over the 66 m bar — two tall dark windows between strips — over a one-storey dark base; tower B's west face is pixel on its north ~11 m with one slit column at its middle, white bays with dark window columns on the rest, the pixel strip reaching the street under the field's south end; a stacked balcony column projects west at the building's SW corner with a light bulkhead on the roof above it; tower A's north and west faces are pixel; the deck in plan: the pool along the 23rd St edge with a row of loungers on its south side, turf and teal chairs west of them, a dark-canopied cabana south of the turf, a small blue spa at the pool's west end.
sources.S18: humphreys_05.jpg (S7), 2026-09-06: a second spa at the pool's EAST end sharing its coping (S11's 'two hot tubs'), 3 FT 0 IN on the coping, blue mosaic on the raised sides; palms in square blue-mosaic planters ~1.8 m square at the pool's far (west) end; blue loungers in a row on the turf side; string lights; the jumbotron wall at the deck's east end with tower B's balcony face behind it.
sources.S19: Humphreys' own photographs at full resolution (humphreys.com, 2026-09-07: StandardAustin_Ext_01/14/41 at 2560 px, = S6/S5/S7), read at 2-3x crops. The WINDOW SYSTEM, the same on the podium (Ext_14, the Pearl face from the street), on tower B's north face (Ext_41 from the deck, Ext_14 from the corner) and on its west face: every window is a tall light in a thin CHARCOAL frame (~0.1 m), and on the bays that carry rust the rust is a wood-look SPANDREL PANEL of the window's own width directly under the sill, ~0.6-0.7 m tall, inside the same frame — not a strip beside the window; the light band between one unit's rust and the next storey's head is ~0.3-0.4 m. On the podium the bays alternate strictly: a window-with-rust bay, then a JULIET bay (a recessed door ~1.6 m wide behind a black rail), then a window-with-rust — a module of two ~3.1 m bays; on the Pearl face the rust window is the bay nearest the corner bay. On tower B's north face two window columns in three carry the rust. Tower A's north face (Ext_01 at 2x, 37 px per metre): the storey is 117 px, a dark mark 22 px = 0.60 m = ONE 0.634 m course tall, a minority two, never a clump — 2.4-7 m long; the field is two tones (light, charcoal) with a few mid-grey planks and no rust. Tower B's field (Ext_14, right edge) carries occasional RUST planks besides. The podium's top storey next to the corner bay carries THREE one-window-wide louvre panels (Ext_14: three; Ext_01 profile: dark runs ~1.05 m wide at 1.5, 4.0 and 9.2 m from the corner bay) where the windows would be, with a juliet between the second and third.
sources.S20: The judge's Earth south-west oblique (S8/S13) clustered (k-means, k=4) over the upper south face on 2026-09-07: white panel #dce2e1 45 %, shaded panel #aeb5b5 29 %, sunlit window #7e8688 18 %, window depths #41494b 8 % — rust under 5 %. Ours at the same camera before this round: near-black #1e2121 32 %, rust #8f4521 11 %, field #b5a997 54 %. The app's daylight multiplies a wall hex by about (0.80, 0.745, 0.68) at that camera (#e2e3df drew as #b5a997; the roof's #c9cdd1 as #948e85), so Earth's absolute white is out of reach and the fields are set as high as the family allows; the dark share is the glass, set to the sunlit read.
sources.S21: The leasing site (thestandardaustin.com, 2026-09-07): its hero is Ext_01 again; three deck slices — the deck's north-end pergola is PALE (white posts, a light slatted roof) in front of a CHARCOAL slatted fence, the chairs on the turf teal, the planters lime green boxes and blue-mosaic squares, the spa coping 3 FT 0 IN. Landmark's own page carries only stock interiors and an Atlanta skyline.

_frame_src: obbOf(ring) as js/westcampus.js computes it: L=94.88, W=46.45, +u bearing 274.7° (west). Same numbers the westcampus bake's (u,v) measurements were made in (S9).

levels._src: 17 storeys to 58.2 m T.O. (S3). Ground floor 6.0: the storefront band is 1.9x a residential floor in S5 (the bake's base read 7.0 from the same photo, S9); podium levels 2-6 at 3.1 to 21.5 = the LiDAR deck (S9) = the 7th-floor amenity deck (S4); level 7 is 4.0 tall (the double-volume gym and sky lounge sit at it, S4/S6); levels 8-17 at 3.17 reach the roof slab at 57.2 with a 1.0 parapet to 58.2. Per-floor heights are derived, not measured.
levels._heights_src: roofA 57.2 + 1.0 parapet = 58.2 T.O. (S3): tower A is the 17-storey element — from the NW oblique (S8) its roof stands clearly above tower B's, and from the S (S8) a pixel-clad top rises above the continuous 9-row south elevation. Everything else (tower B, the bars round the light wells) is two storeys lower: 9 window rows above the ~20 m garage roof from the south (S8) = level 15's ceiling at 50.86. ±1 storey: read off the photogrammetry mesh, no drawing found.

colours._src: day hex; golden and night come from js/westcampus.js's ramp() unless a full trio is given. Sources per tone. The 2026-09-06 pass re-sampled the wall tones in DAYLIGHT off the Earth obliques (S17) and cross-checked them against the owner's eyeball values (S14) — the previous tones were measured at blue hour (S9) and lifted, and read tan/cream beside Earth at the judge's camera.

pixWhite._src: the pixel field's off-white: Earth's sunlit panel #dce2e1 (S20), the owner's ~#e9e9e7 (S14); set at the top of the family because the app's daylight draws #e2e3df as #b5a997 (S20) — was #e4e5e1

pixPale._src: the mid-grey plank scattered through the light field (S15, tower B's west face at 3x; the bake's STD_PALE #bab9b0, S9)

pixDark._src: the dark plank: S14 ~#4a4e54; S16 k-means #4c5153 at dusk; S17 #3c4653 in Earth's shade — the middle value

white._src: the white bays' field (tower B, the south bar): Earth #dce2e1 sunlit / #aeb5b5 shaded (S20); a hair under pixWhite so the two skins read as one family — was #e2e3df, which drew beige (S20)

podiumPanel._src: the podium's panel: a step warmer and darker than the tower white — Ext_14 from the street at blue hour #d8d5cc against the tower's #dcdcd6 (S19); was #cfd0cb, which drew as mud under the app's daylight (S20)

rust._src: the rust accent strip: S14 ~#c1622e; S9 STD_RUST #a56938 lifted from blue hour; S17 #a8553a in Earth — the middle

charcoal._src: the corner bay and the ground floor: S9 BASE_STD #3f4348; S16 sign-band k-means #353b46 at dusk; S17 dark base #42444a

frame._src: storefront mullions and window reveals: taken as the coping's aluminium (STD_CAP); not separately sampled

colours._glass_src: punched-window glass: by day the SUNLIT read — Earth's window cluster #7e8688 (18 % of the south face, S20) is sky reflected in the pane, and through the app's daylight multiplier (S20) #8fa3b0 lands near it; golden a grey-blue; night the dark unlit pane (lit panes take APARTMENTS.nightLitTone). Was #2c3439 by day, which put 32 % of the south face at near-black against Earth's 8 % (S20).
colours._storeGlass_src: storefront glazing, amber-lit at night in S5/S6
colours._stackGlass_src: the corner bay's glazed stack: floor-to-ceiling glass that reflects the sky by day (S15) and is lit warm at dusk (S5)
colours._gymGlass_src: the double-volume gym's glass wall, lit at night in S6
colours._roof_src: white membrane roofs in the nadir (S8), entered cool the way S12 enters top faces; night as S12 deck
colours._pool_src: S14 ~#35a8c8 (photo 2, the pool's blue tile), brighter than S12's pool (#2f86ad, entered for an unlit pool); night as S12
colours._spaTile_src: the spa's and planters' blue mosaic sides (S18, S14 photo 3): darker and greyer than the water
colours._turf_src: S14 ~#7ac143 (photo 2: vivid synthetic green); S17 turf #7cae45 in Earth; night as S12
colours._lounger_src: the blue loungers along the pool (S14 photo 2/3, S18)
colours._chair_src: the teal chairs and tables on the turf (S14 photo 2, S18)
colours._palmTrunk_src: a palm trunk (S18) — a look, not sampled
colours._palmCrown_src: a palm crown (S18) — a look, not sampled
colours._canopy_src: the cabanas' dark flat canopies (S14 photo 2)
colours._slat_src: the dark slatted privacy screen (S14 photo 2)
colours._screen_src: S12 screen (the jumbotron: near-black by day, lit at night)
colours._sign_src: S12 signw (the white channel letters of the horizontal signs, backlit at night)
colours._signVert_src: the vertical letters stand on a white column of the pixel field (S16): white on white does not read from 220 m, so the day tone is the letters' shadowed metal, a step under the field; lit white at night (S6)
colours._condenser_src: the rooftop condenser units: mid grey in the nadir (S8), entered like S12's mech tone; night as the deck
colours._railOpen_src: the tube rail of a projecting balcony stack, drawn as a solid box by the generator but mostly air in the photographs (S7, S19): a mid average of black bars and the light wall and sky behind them, so the stack reads as light slabs with a darker rail (Earth SW at the corner, S17) and not as a column of grey boxes — round 4's #5d6268 still read as boxes at the judge's camera; the juliets keep the black `rail`
colours._louvre_src: the podium's louvre panels (S16, S19): a dark grey a step lighter than the charcoal

skins._src: each skin is a rule; its numbers are below with their source

pixel._src: panel courses of 0.634 m (five per 3.17 m storey: S16/S19, tower A's north face at 2x of the 2560 px original — the storey 117 px, a mark 22 px) in planks of ~2.4 m in a running bond; the tone is decided per macro cell of ONE course by ONE plank (S19: the marks are one course tall, a minority two, never a clump — round 3 had macro [2,1], which stacked into T- and L-shaped blobs 2.5-3.8 m tall at the NW camera), and runs of one to three planks make marks 2.4, 4.8 and 7.2 m long (S14 photo 3's 'two or three distinct sizes', S16's 2.4-7 m); dark 24 % (S16 k-means 26 %, S19 25 %, S14 '~30 %'), a few mid-grey planks (S15), the rest white. Two slit columns per blank flank at ~0.45 and ~0.85 of its width, 0.9 x 2.2 m (S6, tower A's west face; S8).

pixelA._src: tower A's north face: one lit slit column at 0.29 of the width from the east end (S16) and one near the west corner (S8 NW); the vertical sign at 0.68 on its own white column. panel courses of 0.634 m (five per 3.17 m storey: S16/S19, tower A's north face at 2x of the 2560 px original — the storey 117 px, a mark 22 px) in planks of ~2.4 m in a running bond; the tone is decided per macro cell of ONE course by ONE plank (S19: the marks are one course tall, a minority two, never a clump — round 3 had macro [2,1], which stacked into T- and L-shaped blobs 2.5-3.8 m tall at the NW camera), and runs of one to three planks make marks 2.4, 4.8 and 7.2 m long (S14 photo 3's 'two or three distinct sizes', S16's 2.4-7 m); dark 24 % (S16 k-means 26 %, S19 25 %, S14 '~30 %'), a few mid-grey planks (S15), the rest white.

pixelB._src: tower B's west face, the north 11 m: one slit column at the middle of the field (S17 NW at 6x). panel courses of 0.634 m (five per 3.17 m storey: S16/S19, tower A's north face at 2x of the 2560 px original — the storey 117 px, a mark 22 px) in planks of ~2.4 m in a running bond; the tone is decided per macro cell of ONE course by ONE plank (S19: the marks are one course tall, a minority two, never a clump — round 3 had macro [2,1], which stacked into T- and L-shaped blobs 2.5-3.8 m tall at the NW camera), and runs of one to three planks make marks 2.4, 4.8 and 7.2 m long (S14 photo 3's 'two or three distinct sizes', S16's 2.4-7 m); dark 24 % (S16 k-means 26 %, S19 25 %, S14 '~30 %'), a few mid-grey planks (S15), the rest white. This field, and the strip of it that reaches the street, carries occasional RUST planks (S19: Ext_14's right edge) — 4 %.

pixelPlain._src: the pixel field with no slits: the ~4 m strip that reaches the street on the Pearl podium under tower B's field (S15, S17), and the podium's top storey under the tower; with tower B's rust planks (S19)

bays._src: the south elevation and tower B's west face south of the pixel: two 1.1 m windows per 5 m module (S17: rust every ~5 m over the 66 m bar in Earth, two tall dark windows between), the rust under the LEFT window of each module (lower s) and none under the right. the window unit (S19): a tall light in a 0.1 m charcoal frame, sill 1.0 above the floor line, the rust spandrel 0.62 m tall under the frame's sill strip (0.28-0.9 above the floor) on the bays that carry it, the light band below it. The south bar was never photographed close and Earth's texture at 220 m cannot separate a column of spandrels from a strip — the rule is the one every photographed face of the same window system follows (S19), and its rust share (4 %) is what Earth's cluster shows (S20). Was: 2.5 m bays, a 0.55 m rust STRIP on alternate bay lines full height (11 % rust), 1.25 x 2.3 windows in near-black glass.

baysB._src: tower B's north face over the deck: six windows of 1.3 m at 2.66 m centres across 15.95 m (S16 at 4x), grouped in threes so two columns in three carry the rust spandrel (S19: Ext_41 from the deck — the double column at the middle has light spandrels, the columns either side rust). the window unit (S19): a tall light in a 0.1 m charcoal frame, sill 1.0 above the floor line, the rust spandrel 0.62 m tall under the frame's sill strip (0.28-0.9 above the floor) on the bays that carry it, the light band below it. The two balcony columns are on the face, each in front of a window. Was: a 0.7 m rust strip beside every window with a floorLine break (round 2).

court._src: the faces round the light wells and the gym's flanks: white with one window per bay in the charcoal frame of the window unit (S19) — the NW oblique (S8) shows the west well's far wall so; designenvironments_00.jpg, the courtyard from above; no rust seen

podium._src: the podium's light panel (S5/S6/S14/S19): bays alternate strictly — a window bay with the rust spandrel, then a juliet-door bay (a 1.6 m opening behind the black rail, no rust) — a module of 6.2 m (two ~3.1 m bays; Ext_01's juliets at ~6 m centres, Ext_14's window/juliet/window from the street), drawn as one 6.2 m bay with two openings: the rust window 1.3 m wide 1.55 m below the bay centre (lower s) and the door 1.6 m wide 1.55 m above it. the window unit (S19): a tall light in a 0.1 m charcoal frame, sill 1.0 above the floor line, the rust spandrel 0.62 m tall under the frame's sill strip (0.28-0.9 above the floor) on the bays that carry it, the light band below it. The juliets on the door bays are the faces' `balconies`, at the door positions the face's own module gives (each wall piece sets its module from its length: n = round(len / 6.2)). Was: 3.1 m bays, a 0.8 m rust STRIP beside the window on every third bay with a floorLine break, juliets on those same bays.

storefront._src: full-height storefront glazing on ~1.5 m mullions with a transom at about 3/4 height and a charcoal fascia under the floor above (S5); the panes sit 0.25 m behind the fascia line

charcoal._src: the corner bay's charcoal panel with two columns of tall punched windows per street face beside the glazed stack (S15: two per floor on each face) — 4.0 m bays over the ~8 m of each face outside the stack; the windows in the light aluminium frame the photograph shows on the charcoal (S19)

charcoalBlank._src: the corner bay's windowless top storey that carries the signs (S15), and its faces that show only above the podium

glassStack._src: the corner bay's four-storey glazed stack at 23rd and Pearl (S5/S15; S6): floor-to-ceiling glass per storey with a thin charcoal spandrel — one 2.3 x 2.7 m light per 2.6 m bay, the sill 0.25 above the floor; ~5 m of the 23rd St face and ~3 m of the Pearl face

garage._src: NOT WORN since 2026-09-06 (kept for the record): the first read had the south and east podium faces as the 640-space garage's screening (S4; the garage abuts the south face in the nadir, S8) — charcoal with horizontal aluminium louvres at a plausible 0.5 m. The judge's frame (S13) shows the units WRAP the garage: the bays skin runs down the south face to a one-storey dark base, and from 220 m the louvres read as pixel noise on a six-storey charcoal band. Faces 4-6 and the Pearl strip's notch face wear the bays over a flat charcoal ground floor now.

gym._src: the double-volume glazed gym box between the towers at deck level (S4, S6)

podiumR._src: the podium skin mirrored — the door at the lower s of each module and the rust window at the higher — for the Pearl face, whose s runs from the south end and whose bay nearest the corner bay is a rust window (S19: Ext_14 from the street)

louvreTop._src: the podium's top storey on the 10.1 m next to the corner bay (u 71.5-81.6): three one-window-wide dark louvre panels where the windows would be (S19: Ext_14 shows three, Ext_01's profile puts them ~1.5, 4.0 and 9.2 m from the corner bay), drawn as 1.1 x 2.4 m openings in the louvre tone at the piece's window positions. A louvre may be 'lit' after dark like any opening (APARTMENTS.nightLit) — one of three, most nights; accepted.

balcony._src: S9 (TIER4: BW 2.8, BP 1.15, BT 0.28, BR 0.95, BX 0.12 read off Ext_01 against the panel module); the rail drawn 0.06 thick as three thin boxes, the photograph's tube rail (S7), in `railOpen` on the projecting stacks (a solid box standing for bars and air). A juliet stack overrides proj/slabT/railH on itself (S15: ~0.35 m deep, a 1.05 m black rail) and keeps the black `rail`.

blocks._src: the footprint east of the corner bay and the Pearl strip, 0 to the level-7 deck (S2, levels); the north face is retail storefront under five storeys of light panel with rust strips and juliets (S5/S6/S14/S16); the south and east faces are the white/rust bays over a one-storey dark base (S13/S17)

faces._src: edge 0 = the 23rd St face (s runs east to west from u=16.6): storefront, then the podium skin — the juliet on every door bay of the face's own module over s 0-54.9 (nine modules of 6.1 m; the 10.1 m next to the corner bay is the louvre override's own piece with its own juliet). Edges 1 and 2 stand against the corner bay: not drawn. Edge 3 (u=90.95, v 11-41.25) is tower B's west face plane: below 18.4 it is inside the Pearl strip, between 18.4 and 21.5 it shows as the tower's base — the bays skin, and the pixel under the tower's field by the override below (S15). Edges 4-6 (the notch's west wall, the south face, the SE step): the white/rust bays of the south bar run straight down to the ground floor (S13/S17 — twelve rows over the neighbouring garage's roof, the same rhythm top to bottom), on a ONE-storey dark base: flat charcoal on the south face and the SE step, which stand against the garage (S8) and show nothing, and the storefront on edge 4, which faces the notch off Pearl where S13 shows the cafe's glazing.

overrides._src: the same bands as face 5, cut at u=25 so the piece under the south bar (u 25-90.95) is exactly the bar's length: the bays skin sets its module from the wall's length, and one piece 65.95 m long puts every rust strip on the line of the one above it at 21.5; the 8.1 m east of it sits under tower A's leg
the east face above the lower east wing (z1 15.3); below it is inside the wing
edge 3 under tower B's pixel field (v 11-22): the tower's base storey wears the pixel (S5/S15)

the 10.1 m of the 23rd St face next to the corner bay (u 71.5-81.6), one piece so its module is its own: two 5.05 m modules put the rust windows at u 72.5 and 77.5 and the doors at 75.6 and 80.6; the juliet on the first door only (S19: Ext_01 has a rail ~6.8 m from the corner bay and thin frame lines at ~1.5 m), and the top storey is the three louvre panels (louvreTop) at the piece's window positions. Round 3 had two 2.4 m override pieces here, each of which restarted the bays module on a strip bay, so three rust strips crowded the corner bay.

blocks._parapet_src: a low upstand round the deck; the deck's own guard is the glass rail in `deck.items` (S5/S6). Height 0.5 is a look.

roofItems._src: a row of blue loungers along the pool's south side (S14 photo 2, S18): ten at ~2.6 m centres over the pool's length, 0.7 x 1.7 m, 0.5 m high — the count and pitch read by eye off S18; a roofItems grid because the boxes are placed in the building frame, so the row may run over the corner bay's roof, which is the same deck
teal chairs and tables on the turf (S14 photo 2, S18): a look, eight of them
the condensers clustered in the deck's east corner behind the slatted screen (S14 photo 2; S6 shows dark units beside the jumbotron wall)

blocks._src: the charcoal corner volume at 23rd and Pearl carrying THE STANDARD on both faces: 13.3 m along 23rd (S9, from Ext_14), ~11 m along Pearl (S5: three window bays), full podium height — charcoal from the storefront fascia to the parapet on both street faces (S15), NOT a one-storey band: the glazed stack at the corner and two columns of punched windows beside it for four storeys, then the windowless sign-band storey (18.4-21.5) with the letters; its roof is the pool deck (S6/S8) with the deck's glass rail on top (S5)

faces._src: signs: white channel letters ~0.85 m tall in the windowless top storey of both street faces (S5/S15): on 23rd (v0, s from the west corner) the text block starts ~0.6 m from the corner and runs ~9.2 m; on Pearl (u1, s from the south end) it starts 1.3 m from the south end and runs 8.2 m, ending ~1.5 m short of the corner. Was: dot 0.15 letters 1.05 m tall starting 1.2 m in. The small black balconies (1.6 m wide, ~1 m deep) stand on the 23rd St face just east of the glazed stack on the four window storeys (S15). u0 stands against the podium; v1 shows only above the Pearl strip's 18.4 roof.

overrides._src: the glazed corner stack on the 23rd St face: the west ~5.2 m of the face (S15: two lights wide), four storeys, under the sign band
the glazed stack's return on the Pearl face: the north ~2.9 m (S15: one light wide)

blocks._src: the 4-storey strip along Pearl between the corner bay and the SW notch: 4 window rows above the ground floor with juliet balconies (S5/S15), parapet at 18.4 + 1.1; tower B stands 4 m behind its face (S5 setback; the nadir S8 shows the step at u≈91). Under the south end of the tower's pixel field a ~4 m strip of the podium wears the pixel down to the storefront (S15, S17: the field reads as one surface from the street to the roof there), light podium either side of it.

faces._src: u0 and v0 stand against the podium and the corner bay; v1 faces the SW notch off Pearl and wears the strip's own bands (storefront, then the mirrored podium panel) — S13 shows the cafe's glazing and light panel there. u1 = the Pearl face (s from the south end): the pixel strip at v 18.6-22.6 cuts it into a south piece (s 0-18.65, three 6.2 m modules) and a north piece (s 22.65-30.25, one module), each with the mirrored podium skin so the bay nearest the corner bay is a rust window (S19); the juliets stand on the door bays of those modules — three on the south piece, one on the north (Ext_14 from the street: window, juliet, window, juliet along Pearl).

overrides._src: the ~4 m pixel strip that reaches the street under the south end of tower B's field (v 18.6-22.6): S15 (the strip between two light podium sections in Ext_14), S17 (Earth NW at 6x: the field continuous from the roof to the storefront there); its width and place are read by eye — ±1.5 m

roofItems._src: a light bulkhead on the strip's roof in front of tower B's white bays (S17, Earth NW at 6x: a two-storey-looking light box with a dark top standing on the strip about two thirds along); height a look

blocks._src: the 17-storey pixel tower at the north-east of the upper building, an L: the north bar u 17-42 x v 8-19 (S8 nadir: the condenser roof north of the east light well; S6: set 8 m behind 23rd St with the deck in front) and the east leg u 17-25 down the east end (S8 south view: the pixel face shows FULL HEIGHT at the east end of the south elevation, ~8 m wide). Pixel on the north, east, west and south-end faces (S6/S8/S17); the vertical sign on the north face at 0.68 of its width from the east end (S16) — not at the east end, as first read; the faces on the east light well are the plain white of the well walls.
